referenceSources.title: 1994 Lancia Delta HF Integrale Evoluzione II | Driving into Summer | RM  Sotheby's
referenceSources.description:
A striking Monza Red 1994 Lancia Delta HF Integrale Evoluzione II sits on a paved surface, showcasing its rally‑inspired design. The front fascia features quad round headlights flanking a central Lancia badge and an HF emblem, while the wide fenders and sharp body lines emphasize its performance heritage. Under the hood lies a 215‑horsepower 2.0‑liter 16‑valve turbocharged inline‑four with sequential multi‑point fuel injection and a Garrett turbocharger, mated to a five‑speed manual gearbox.

This example has recorded just under 38,000 kilometers and retains factory protective plastic on many interior panels, including rear door trims and carpeting. Previously part of a Japanese collection, it underwent comprehensive service in October 2019—valve clearance checks, air conditioning recharge, coolant flush, oil change, and wheel refinishing—ensuring its exceptional condition. The Evoluzione II’s heavy‑duty suspension, ABS brakes, Recaro seats, and Momo steering wheel complete the package, making this low‑mileage Delta a rare and highly sought‑after rally legend.
